Meta.title: Küsimustik
Meta.description: Build surveys, collect responses and read the results.

Language.label: Language
Language.description: The language of the app. A survey's own language is set on the survey.

Surveys.title: Surveys
Surveys.waveGroupCount: {count, plural, one {# wave series} other {# wave series}}

meta.responsesArchived: {count, plural, one {# response archived} other {# responses archived}}

empty.title: No surveys yet
empty.body: Start from an empty survey, add questions and share the link. Responses and charts will appear here.

noResults.title: No survey matches this search
noResults.body: Try a different search term, or another status.

create.title: New survey
create.body: Give the survey a name. Questions come next; the name can be changed later.
create.localeHelp: The language respondents see the survey in. It does not change the app's language.

rename.title: Rename
rename.body: The new name is visible to respondents too.

duplicate.title: Duplicate survey
duplicate.body: The copy gets the same questions and stays part of the same wave series, so results can be compared year over year later. It is a draft and only gets its own link when published.
duplicate.waveLabelHelp: Optional. Used as the series label in comparison charts.

publish.title: Publish survey
publish.body: The survey becomes public and starts collecting responses. Anyone with the link can answer.
publish.bodyReopen: The survey starts collecting responses again. The old link keeps working.

close.title: Close survey
close.body: The survey stops collecting responses. Existing responses and the link are kept, and the survey can be reopened later.

delete.title: Delete survey
delete.body: “{title}” and all of its responses will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.bodyWithResponses: “{title}” and its {count, plural, one {# response} other {# responses}} will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

errors.invalidInput: Those details are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.notFound: Survey not found. It may already have been deleted.
errors.conflict: The survey changed elsewhere in the meantime. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.noQuestions: An empty survey cannot be published. Add at least one question.
errors.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

empty.title: No questions yet
empty.body: Add the first question. You can reorder them here later.

empty.title: Nothing to preview
empty.body: Add a question and you will see it here the way a respondent does.

preview.unavailable: The preview arrives with this type's editor.

editor.title: Settings

keyHelp.derive: Derived from the title. The key joins waves and names the CSV columns, so it locks when you publish.
keyHelp.freeze: Locked: answers or other waves already point at this key.

editor.titlePlaceholder: What do you want to ask?

empty.title: Nothing selected
empty.body: Pick an element from the list on the left, or from the preview.

unavailable.title: The editor is not ready yet
unavailable.body: “{type}” questions can be reordered and deleted for now. The editor arrives in the next step.

dnd.instructions: Press space to pick an element up. Move it with the arrow keys, drop it with space, cancel with Escape.

Auth.title: Sign in
Auth.subtitle: We'll email you a sign-in link. No password needed.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It is valid for one hour and only opens in this browser.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.sendFailed: The link could not be sent. Try again.
errors.linkInvalid: This sign-in link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.wrongBrowser: Open the link in the same browser you started from.

Errors.title: Something went wrong
Errors.body: This part could not be loaded.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: This page does not exist, or it has been removed.
